lines.en: label karindate20:
I tap on Karin’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Karin 的名字，等着她接。

lines.en: Soccer practice has already ended for the day, so she’s likely either on her way home right now or...
lines.zh: 今天的足球训练已经结束了，所以她现在多半要么正在回家的路上，要么……

lines.en: I don’t know. Doing something else?
lines.zh: 我也不知道。在做点别的？

lines.en: It’s not like I have a tracking device on her or anything.
lines.zh: 我又没在她身上装追踪器什么的。

lines.en: Though, if I separated everyone I know into two categories of “Would let me install a tracking device inside of them” and “Wouldn’t do that...”
lines.zh: 不过，要是我把认识的所有人分成「会同意我把追踪器装进他们体内」和「不会同意我这么干……」两类的话——

lines.en: I think Karin would probably be in the first group.
lines.zh: 我觉得 Karin 大概会被分到第一类里。

lines.en: : AAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!!
lines.zh: : AAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!!

lines.en: : Hi.
: What the fuck was that?
lines.zh: : 刚才那他妈的是什么鬼？

lines.en: : I’m sorry...I’m just really frustrated right now.
lines.zh: : 对不起……我现在真的超级烦躁。

lines.en: : I didn’t hurt your ear, did I?
lines.zh: : 没把你耳朵震坏吧？

lines.en: : Did you say something? I can’t really hear you over the constant ringing in my ears.
lines.zh: : 你刚才说话了吗？我耳朵里一直嗡嗡响，实在听不清你在说什么。

lines.en: : Ah! Sensei, no! I didn’t mean to!
lines.zh: : 啊！Sensei，不要！我不是故意的！

lines.en: : Do you need medical attention? Should I come meet you somewhere?
lines.zh: : 要不要叫医生？要不要我去哪儿找你？

lines.en: : Where are you? I’ll bring my first aid kit and-
lines.zh: : 你在哪儿？我把急救箱带上然后——

lines.en: : Karin, chill. I’m fine.
lines.zh: : Karin，冷静点。我没事。

lines.en: : Just a little surprised to hear you of all people yelling.
lines.zh: : 只是没想到会听到你这样的人大喊大叫，有点意外。

lines.en: : I know, I know...It’s just my stupid little sister.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道……都怪我那个蠢妹妹。

lines.en: : Just kidding. She’s not stupid. I love her.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。她不蠢。我爱她。

lines.en: : But really. It’s Kirin. She’s been getting on my nerves a lot lately and I don’t even have anyone to talk about it with since all of my friends are {i}also{/i} her friends.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。是 Kirin。她最近老是把我的神经挑得不行，可我连个能说这事的人都没有，因为我所有的朋友{i}同时{/i}也是她的朋友。

lines.en: : All of them?
lines.zh: : 全部都是？

lines.en: : Well...all of the ones I’d normally complain about stuff to.
lines.zh: : 嗯……至少我平时会去发牢骚的那些都是。

lines.en: : Well...I’m available if you want to vent to me.
lines.zh: : 那……你要是想找人倾诉的话，我可以听。

lines.en: if karinlied == False:
: Karin?
lines.zh: : Karin？

lines.en: : And you’ll keep anything I say hidden from her even though...you two are...
lines.zh: : 而且我说什么你都会替我瞒着她，哪怕……你俩是……

lines.en: : Sure. Just because I was honest about my relationship with her to you doesn’t mean we can’t talk anymore.
lines.zh: : 当然。我只是对你坦白了我和她的关系，不代表我们就不能再说话了。

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: Yeah, okay. That’s...fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧。那样……也行。

lines.en: else:
: Do you...
: Do you really mean that?
lines.zh: : 你说的是真的吗？

lines.en: : You’re okay with me taking up a bunch of your time just to complain about stupid stuff that you’re in no way involved with?
lines.zh: : 你真的不介意我占掉你一大把时间，就为了跟你抱怨一堆跟你完全没关系的破事？

lines.en: : {i}As long as I can be with you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}只要能和你在一起就好。{/i}

lines.en: : S-Stop saying that!
lines.zh: : 别、别再说了！

lines.en: : You said that at the locker room too and it made my heart go all GAAAAAAAAAHHH.
lines.zh: : 你在更衣室的时候也说过这句话，听得我整颗心都在 GAAAAAAAAAHHH。

lines.en: : AAAAAAAAHHH I JUST WANNA YELL!
lines.zh: : AAAAAAAAHHH 我只是想大喊一场！

lines.en: : There’s um...
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯……

lines.en: : There’s a new diner by my house if you’d want to maybe meet there?
lines.zh: : 我家附近新开了一家餐厅，你要不要去那里碰面？

lines.en: : That works for me. Just send me the address and I’ll start heading over.
lines.zh: : 我没问题。把地址发我，我现在就出发。

lines.en: : Okay! Cool!
lines.zh: : 好！太好了！

lines.en: : I’ll...do that right now then!
lines.zh: : 那我……现在就发！

lines.en: : Sweet.
lines.zh: : 甜啊。

lines.en: : Yeah! Really sweet!
lines.zh: : 嗯！真的超甜！

lines.en: : Yup.
: So...sweet...
: Anyway, bye!
lines.zh: : 总之，拜拜！

lines.en: Karin awkwardly hangs up the phone and sends me the address of the diner we’re meeting at a few seconds later...
lines.zh: Karin 尴尬地挂断电话，几秒后把我们约好见面的那家餐厅的地址发了过来……

lines.en: scene black
scene karinangrybreakfast1
: I’m sorry for ordering so many sweets. I always crave sugar when I get angry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我点了这么多甜食。我一生气就特别想吃糖。

lines.en: : That is possibly the cutest reaction to getting angry I have ever heard.
lines.zh: : 这大概是我听过的、生气时最可爱的反应了。

lines.en: : I’m so angry I’m not even going to react to you using the C word at me.
lines.zh: : 我气到连你对我用那个 C 开头的词都懒得反应了。

lines.en: : Wow. It must be really bad then, huh?
lines.zh: : 哇。那看来真的很严重啊？

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast2
: I’m always so nice to her and she treats me like I’m the worst thing in the world!
lines.zh: : 我对她那么那么好，她却把我当成世界上最讨厌的东西！

lines.en: : Like, I get that you’re automatically supposed to be jealous of me since I’m the older sibling, but cut me some gosh darn slack already!
lines.zh: : 我是说，我懂，当姐姐的本来就该被妹妹嫉妒，可她也该给我留点余地了吧！

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast3
: I’m sorry for my language, too. You shouldn’t have had to hear that.
lines.zh: : 我也得为刚才的用词道歉。你不该听到那些话的。

lines.en: : I’m really seeing a brand new side of you today.
lines.zh: : 我今天真是看到了你全新的一面。

lines.en: : I’m sorry...I made you walk all the way over here and I’m just...jumping straight into things before you’ve even gotten to eat.
lines.zh: : 对不起……我让你大老远跑过来，结果你还没吃东西，我就……直接开始倒苦水了。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t worry about that. I’m not really hungry.
lines.zh: : 哦，别在意。我也不是很饿。

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast4
: What? No. Tell me that’s not true. Please be hungry.
lines.zh: : 什么？别啊。快说不是真的。求你饿一点吧。

lines.en: : I don’t want to have to eat all of this by myself. I’ll get diabetes.
lines.zh: : 我可不想一个人吃光这些东西。我会得糖尿病的。

lines.en: : Well you should have thought of that before your anger-induced sweet tooth kicked in.
lines.zh: : 那你在被怒气勾起甜食瘾之前就该想到这一点啊。

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast5
: Maybe if I just...don’t have another cheat day until next winter it will be okay?...
lines.zh: : 也许只要我……在明年冬天之前不再搞什么「欺骗日」，就没问题了吧？……

lines.en: : So, what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 所以，到底出了什么事？

lines.en: : There had to be something in particular for you to get like this, right?
lines.zh: : 肯定是有什么特别的事才让你变成这样的，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, but...
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过……

lines.en: : I might come off as a little needy or...annoying once I start explaining things.
lines.zh: : 等我开始解释的时候，可能会显得有点黏人，或者……很烦人。

lines.en: : Are you okay with that?
lines.zh: : 这样你也无所谓吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have come if I wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 要是有所谓，我就不会来了。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast6
: You know how you’re going to the beach soon, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你们很快要去海边吧？

lines.en: : In the middle of winter. Yes.
lines.zh: : 在大冬天的。知道。

lines.en: : And you remember how I came with you last time?
lines.zh: : 你还记得上次我也跟着去了吧？

lines.en: : In the middle of summer. Yes.
lines.zh: : 在大夏天的。记得。

lines.en: : Yeah. Exactly.
lines.zh: : 嗯。就是那个。

lines.en: Oh. Okay. I guess there won’t be any bigger reaction to the weird blurs in time with Karin.
lines.zh: 哦。好吧。看来和 Karin 之间那些诡异的时间错位，是不会引发什么更大的反应了。

lines.en: Either that or she’s just so infuriated that it went completely over her head.
lines.zh: 要么就是她气得彻底没往那边想。

lines.en: : So...I had a lot of fun last time.
lines.zh: : 那个……上次我玩得很开心。

lines.en: : Even if Kirin ignored me for most of the trip, I got to hang out with Miku and...almost only killed one person with a baseball bat.
lines.zh: : 就算 Kirin 全程基本无视我，我还是跟 Miku 玩到了，而且……差点只用球棒打死了一个人。

lines.en: : Maya hasn’t been walking the same ever since.
lines.zh: : Maya 从那以后走路的姿势都不一样了。

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast7
: She hasn’t?!
lines.zh: : 真的吗？！

lines.en: : Karin, it was a joke. And please stop hitting the table like that. You’re going to break something.
lines.zh: : Karin，我开玩笑的。还有别再那样砸桌子了。你会把东西砸坏的。

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast4
: I’m sorry...
lines.zh: : 对不起……

lines.en: : But...I was asking her about it this morning because I thought it would be fun to tag along with you guys again...even if I’m not in your class...
lines.zh: : 可是……我今天早上问了她，因为我觉得再跟你们一起去会很好玩……就算我不是你们班的学生……

lines.en: : And she just kept saying all of this stuff about staying out of her personal life and that I wasn’t welcome there.
lines.zh: : 结果她就不停地说什么让我别插手她的私生活，说我不受欢迎。

lines.en: : But I {i}know{/i} that isn’t true because Miku and Ami both invited me already.
lines.zh: : 可我{i}知道{/i}那不是真的，因为 Miku 和 Ami 都已经邀请过我了。

lines.en: : Then what’s the issue? Just show Kirin that you’re your own person and that you can do whatever you want.
lines.zh: : 那问题在哪？就让 Kirin 看看你是独立的个体，你想做什么就做什么。

lines.en: : That’s what I want to do, but...
lines.zh: : 我也想这么做，可是……

lines.en: : I also know that things aren’t really that great between us and that doing something like that after she asked me not to could just...make everything worse.
lines.zh: : 我也知道我们俩的关系本来就不太好，如果她都那样说了我还偏要做，可能只会……让一切变得更糟。

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast5
: So here I sit...in a diner, surrounded by a spread of food that could very well end my athletic career, complaining about it to her teacher.
lines.zh: : 所以我现在就坐在这儿……坐在一家餐厅里，被一堆很可能直接终结我运动生涯的食物包围着，对着她的老师抱怨这件事。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I’m already used to all types of girls complaining about all sorts of things to me.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我早就习惯了各种各样的女生跑来跟我抱怨各种各样的事。

lines.en: : At least you’re not asking me to kill anyone in order to save the world.
lines.zh: : 至少你没要我去杀什么人来拯救世界。

lines.en: : Yeah...I guess things could be worse if-
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想情况还可能更糟，如果——

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast8
: Wait? Killing someone to save the world?
lines.zh: : 等等？杀人来拯救世界？

lines.en: : Is this really the level of problems the other girls you know have? Because if that’s true, I’m going to feel very immature about whining over something so small.
lines.zh: : 你认识的其他女生遇到的麻烦，真的都是这种级别的吗？如果是的话，那我为这么点小事发牢骚就太幼稚了。

lines.en: : It’s a long story. But either way, you shouldn’t feel small no matter what.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。但不管怎样，你都不该觉得自己渺小。

lines.en: : You said there was no one else for you to talk to about this- and I don’t really think I’ll be able to {i}help{/i} in any way other than just listening, but...
lines.zh: : 你说过这事没有别人可以倾诉——我觉得除了听你说，我大概也{i}帮{/i}不上什么忙，不过……

lines.en: : I think it’s healthy for you to get mad.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你生气是好事。

lines.en: : Maybe not the whole...binge eating thing that's going on here, but the anger alone.
lines.zh: : 也许眼前这种……暴饮暴食的行为不算，但光是生气这件事本身。

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast5
: Ugh...I really hate getting angry, though.
lines.zh: : 呃……不过我真的很讨厌生气。

lines.en: : Even when I was a baby, any time my parents disciplined me, I never screamed or cried or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 我还很小的时候，每次爸妈教训我，我都从没尖叫或者哭闹过。

lines.en: : I just sat in my crib and silently sobbed to myself while they watched Jeopardy.
lines.zh: : 我就坐在婴儿床里自己默默抽泣，而他们在旁边看《Jeopardy》。

lines.en: : Huh. Maybe your living situation isn’t as normal as I thought it was after all.
lines.zh: : 呵。看来你的家庭环境并没有我想的那么正常。

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast9
: It’s plenty normal. Really.
lines.zh: : 挺正常的。真的。

lines.en: : I just get overwhelmed really easily and don’t want anyone getting hurt because of me.
lines.zh: : 我只是太容易崩溃，不想因为自己而让任何人受伤。

lines.en: : And sometimes...it feels like Kirin is trying to hurt me on purpose.
lines.zh: : 而且有时候……感觉 Kirin 像是在故意伤我的心。

lines.en: : Like, what would it matter if I {i}did{/i} come to the beach? Why would {i}that{/i} bother her when she knows full well she’s met a bunch of people through me?
lines.zh: : 比如说，我去了海边又能怎样？她明明很清楚自己认识的那些人都是通过我才认识的，{i}这{/i}有什么好介意的？

lines.en: : Does it not go both ways? Am I not allowed to have a life of my own but she is? How is that fair?
lines.zh: : 这事难道不该是相互的吗？凭什么她能有自己的生活我就不行？这算什么公平？

lines.en: : It’s not.
lines.zh: : 是不公平。

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast7
: Right?!
lines.zh: : 对吧？！

lines.en: : Karin, please.
lines.zh: : Karin，拜托。

lines.en: : I’ll replace it if I really do break the table! I just need this right now, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 真把桌子砸坏了我赔就是了！我现在就是需要这样，Sensei！

lines.en: : I’m so fed up with doing everything to try and get Kirin to like me only to have her be all like...“Grrr! I’m Kirin!”
lines.zh: : 我为了讨 Kirin 欢心什么都做了，结果她只会「吼！我是 Kirin！」这副样子，我真的受够了！

lines.en: : Wonderful impression. I think you’ve found your next career if all of this food really does end your life as an athlete.
lines.zh: : 模仿得真棒。要是这些吃的真把你运动员生涯给终结了，我看你已经找到下一份职业了。

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast10
: AAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : AAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!

lines.en: I turn my gaze to the side to see if anyone is looking over this way and...of course, literally everyone is.
lines.zh: 我侧过头去看有没有人往这边瞧……当然，是真的所有人都在看。

lines.en: : I’M SORRY TO EVERYONE JUST TRYING TO ENJOY THEIR MEALS BUT I AM VERY MAD AND HAVE AN UNGRATEFUL LITTLE SISTER!
lines.zh: : 非常抱歉打扰各位好好吃饭，但我现在非常生气，而且我有个不知好歹的妹妹！

lines.en: : Karin, it doesn’t work that-
lines.zh: : Karin，这样是不行——

lines.en: : Wait, why did everyone go back to eating their food like none of this ever happened?
lines.zh: : 等等，为什么大家又都若无其事地继续吃饭了？

lines.en: if karinlied == False:
scene karinangrybreakfast11
: Sensei...you {i}must{/i} understand her a little better than me, don’t you?
lines.zh: : Sensei……你{i}一定{/i}比我更懂她一点吧？

lines.en: : Since you two are...you know...
lines.zh: : 毕竟你俩是……那个……

lines.en: : The only thing I understand about Kirin is that she’s self destructive in pretty much every way imaginable.
lines.zh: : 关于 Kirin，我唯一能明白的就是她几乎所有方面都在自我毁灭。

lines.en: I also understand that she thoroughly enjoys giving blowjobs, but that isn’t something I feel the need to disclose to Karin.
lines.zh: 我还明白她非常享受给人吹箫，但这事我没必要告诉 Karin。

lines.en: : She’s not supposed to be like that, though.
lines.zh: : 可她不该是那样的啊。

lines.en: : She’s supposed to come to me if she feels like she’s in trouble...or when things become too much for her to bear.
lines.zh: : 她要是遇到麻烦了，或者撑不住了，本该来找我的……

lines.en: : That’s what sisters are for. But if she won’t even come to me, then-
lines.zh: : 姐妹本来就该是这样的。可如果她连我都不肯找，那——

lines.en: : There’s a flaw in what you just said, though, Karin.
lines.zh: : 不过你刚才的话里有个漏洞，Karin。

lines.en: : A flaw?...
: What flaw?
lines.zh: : 什么漏洞？

lines.en: : There is no way that people are “supposed to be.”
lines.zh: : 人是没有什么「本该怎样」的。

lines.en: : Kirin’s her own person who’s going to do things her own way.
lines.zh: : Kirin 是独立的个体，她会用她自己的方式做事。

lines.en: : And it sucks that she’s apparently against you being {i}your{/i} own person, but isn’t a nonsensical decision like that something we should expect from her by now?
lines.zh: : 她显然反对你做{i}自己{/i}，这一点是很糟，但这种不讲理的决定，我们不早就该料到她会做出来了吗？

lines.en: : Just...keep telling her she’s a good girl or something and I’m sure she’ll soften up in time.
lines.zh: : 就……继续跟她说她是个好女孩什么的，我保证她早晚会软下来的。

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast12
: Is that...what you did?...
lines.zh: : 那就是……你做过的事吗？……

lines.en: : To...get her to like you, I mean...
lines.zh: : 我是说……为了让她喜欢上你……

lines.en: : Surprisingly, I didn’t have to do {i}anything{/i} to get her to like me.
lines.zh: : 说来也怪，我{i}什么{/i}都没做她就喜欢上我了。

lines.en: : She just came to me one day and that was that.
lines.zh: : 有一天她就自己找上门来了，就这么简单。

lines.en: : I wish I was that lucky...
lines.zh: : 我要是有那种运气就好了……

lines.en: : If you were born a male, you probably would have been.
lines.zh: : 你要是生为男孩子，大概就有了。

lines.en: : That’s not lucky at all. I’d look at myself in the mirror and immediately faint.
lines.zh: : 那根本不算什么运气。我要是照镜子看见自己那副样子，当场就会晕过去。

lines.en: : I don’t know if your fear would exist if you were-
lines.zh: : 我不知道你要是……

lines.en: : You know what, that doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: : 算了，这不重要。

lines.en: : What does matter is that you don’t let yourself get bogged down by the actions of a girl that literally no one, not even Kirin herself, understands.
lines.zh: : 重要的是，别让一个连 Kirin 自己都不懂的女孩的行为把你给拖垮。

lines.en: : Yeah...
else:
scene karinangrybreakfast5
: I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I just want to understand her.
lines.zh: : 我只是想理解她。

lines.en: : She’s supposed to come to me if she feels like she’s in trouble...or when things become too much for her to bear.
lines.zh: : 她要是遇到麻烦了，或者撑不住了，本该来找我的……

lines.en: : But instead, she just...pushes all of that anger onto the people around her and-
lines.zh: : 可她却……把那些怒气全撒在周围的人身上，然后——

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast13
: Ah! That’s what I’m doing now!
lines.zh: : 啊！我现在就在做这种事！

lines.en: : I’m Kirin Kanda! There is no more Karin!
lines.zh: : 我就是 Kirin Kanda！世上再没有 Karin 了！

lines.en: : Please remain Karin. One Kirin is more than enough for the world.
lines.zh: : 请继续当 Karin 吧。这世上一个 Kirin 就已经绰绰有余了。

lines.en: : Besides, I don’t really count venting like this as “pushing your anger onto other people.”
lines.zh: : 再说，我也不觉得像这样发牢骚算「把怒气撒到别人身上」。

lines.en: : The key difference between you and Kirin is that you don’t actively want to make other people feel bad.
lines.zh: : 你和 Kirin 的关键区别在于，你并不会主动想让别人难受。

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast6
: And you think that she does?...
lines.zh: : 你觉得她会吗？……

lines.en: : At the very least, I think she wants {i}you{/i} to feel bad. And all the evidence I really need for that is the dent you’ve put into our table.
lines.zh: : 至少，我觉得她想让{i}你{/i}难受。而我要证明这一点，只需要看看你给咱们这张桌子砸出的那个坑。

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast14
: Oh my God, did I actually-
lines.zh: : 天哪，我难道真的——

lines.en: : It was just a guess. I don’t know if the table is actually dented or not.
lines.zh: : 我随口猜的。我也不知道桌子到底有没有被砸出坑。

lines.en: : But what I’m trying to get at is that you can’t let yourself get bogged down by the actions of a girl that literally no one, not even Kirin herself, understands.
lines.zh: : 但我想说的是，别让一个连 Kirin 自己都不懂的女孩的行为把你给拖垮。

lines.en: : Yeah...
scene karinangrybreakfast15
: Yeah!
lines.zh: : 没错！

lines.en: : I’m not going to let Kirin decide what I can and can’t do!
lines.zh: : 我不会再让 Kirin 来决定我能做什么、不能做什么！

lines.en: : I’m my own person!
lines.zh: : 我是独立的个体！

lines.en: : I’m gonna go to the beach with my friends!
lines.zh: : 我要和我的朋友去海边！

lines.en: : I’m very proud of-
lines.zh: : 我为你感到非常骄傲——

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast16
The rest of the diner erupts into a fit of applause and people leave their seats to start clapping for Karin.
lines.zh: 餐厅里的其他人爆发出一阵掌声，大家纷纷离座，开始为 Karin 鼓掌。

lines.en: And, in other news, Kumon-mi keeps getting weirder and weirder.
lines.zh: 另外，Kumon-mi 这个地方也是越来越怪了。

lines.en: : Heheh~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~

lines.en: : Thank you very much everyone, but please hold your applause.
lines.zh: : 非常感谢各位，不过请把掌声收一收吧。

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast17
: Sensei...I’m sure I don’t have to say this...but thank you for letting me complain to you today.
lines.zh: : Sensei……我知道这话不用说……但还是谢谢你今天听我发牢骚。

lines.en: : It...definitely {i}is{/i} good that I was able to get all of this off my chest. Even if I’m about to put another fifty pounds on after all of the sugar you are about to watch me consume.
lines.zh: : 能把心里这些话都说出来……{i}真的{/i}很好。哪怕接下来你要看着我吃下那么多糖，然后再胖上五十磅。

lines.en: : Hey, consume away. It wouldn’t be the first time I’ve looked on in curiosity as a girl consumes sugary food.
lines.zh: : 嘿，尽管吃。我又不是第一次好奇地在一旁看女生吃甜食了。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Long story.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Anyway, how are you going to come to the beach if it’s not with Kirin?
lines.zh: : 总之，要是不跟 Kirin 一起去，你打算怎么去海边？

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast18
: Hmm...that’s a good question...
lines.zh: : 嗯……问得好……

lines.en: : I think Miku and Makoto were heading there with Kirin and {i}her{/i} roommate, so...I guess I’ll have to make the trip alone?
lines.zh: : 我记得 Miku 和 Makoto 是跟 Kirin 和{i}她{/i}室友一起去的，所以……我大概只能自己一个人去了？

lines.en: : Would it be weird if you were to come with Ami and the rest of her group?
lines.zh: : 那你要是跟 Ami 她们那组人一起来，会不会很奇怪？

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast19
: With Ami?! The Ami who lives at your house?!
lines.zh: : 跟 Ami？！就是住在你家的那个 Ami？！

lines.en: : Meaning that I would show up to your house really early in the morning to see you waking up and walking around in nothing but a T-shirt?!
lines.zh: : 也就是说我得一大早跑到你家去，然后撞见你刚睡醒、身上只套着一件 T 恤在那儿晃？！

lines.en: : Do you...think that’s just how I walk around the house when there are visitors there?
lines.zh: : 你……该不会以为家里有客人的时候我也会那样晃吧？

lines.en: : I don’t know! Yes? No?
lines.zh: : 我不知道！会吗？不会吗？

lines.en: : Is it?!
lines.zh: : 到底是不是啊？！

lines.en: : Karin-
lines.zh: : Karin——

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast20
: No! Don’t tell me! I don’t wanna know!
lines.zh: : 不要！别告诉我！我不想知道！

lines.en: : I’ll just find out and maybe have to wash my eyes out with soap when I come to your house to tag along with Ami!
lines.zh: : 我自己会发现答案的，说不定等我去你家跟 Ami 汇合的时候，还得用肥皂洗眼睛呢！

lines.en: : Anyway, thanks for talking! Bye, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 总之，谢谢你听我说！拜拜，Sensei！

lines.en: : Karin, hold on a-
lines.zh: : Karin，等一下——

lines.en: scene karinangrybreakfast21
: ...second.
scene karinangrybreakfast22
: Did you forget you ordered breakfast?
lines.zh: : 你忘了自己点了早餐吗？

lines.en: : Mhm...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……

lines.en: : Do you want to pretend you never walked out of the diner?
lines.zh: : 你想假装自己从没走出过这家餐厅吗？

lines.en: : Mhm...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……

lines.en: scene black
Karin winds up only eating around 30%% of what she ordered and stuffs the rest into an assortment of boxes to take home.
lines.zh: Karin 最后只吃掉了自己点的东西里大约 30%%，剩下的全塞进一堆盒子里带回了家。

lines.en: And I think she manages to get over her anger as well, as I can make out the sound of her whispering something about how Kirin will be excited to have pancakes when she gets home.
lines.zh: 而且我觉得她应该是把气消掉了，因为我能隐约听到她小声嘀咕着，说 Kirin 回家看到松饼一定会很开心。

lines.en: $ karin_love += 1
$ karindate20 = True
{i}Karin’s affection has increased to [karin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Karin 的好感度提升到了 [karin_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
